sessionStart.bash: echo '{"additionalContext": "Platform: MyCodeXvantaOS. Read AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md for conventions. Architecture: Local-first, Provider-agnostic, Contract-first, Governance-enforced."}'

preToolUse.bash: ARGS="${COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_ARGS:-}"; if echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|rm -rf \*|rm -rf ~)'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Dangerous recursive deletion blocked"}'; elif echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'git push --force'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Force push not allowed"}'; elif echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'curl.*\| *(sh|bash)'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Remote script execution blocked"}'; else echo '{"decision": "allow"}'; fi

agentStop.bash: cd "${COPILOT_HOOK_CWD:-.}" && npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -10; EXIT=$?; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"decision": "block", "additionalContext": "TypeScript errors detected. Run npm run typecheck to see details and fix before completing."}'; fi

errorOccurred.bash: echo "[ERROR] $(date -Iseconds): Error occurred during session" >> /tmp/copilot-session-errors.log 2>/dev/null || true
